2609.25833.title: ARAFA: An LLM-Generated Arabic Fact-Checking Dataset
2609.25833.paper_summary: Automatic fact-checking poses a significant challenge in Arabic natural language processing due to the scarcity of datasets and resources. In this manuscript, we introduce Arafa, a new large-scale dataset for fact-checking in Modern Standard Arabic, constructed through an automated framework leveraging large language models (LLMs). The dataset was constructed through a three-step pipeline: (1) claim generation from Arabic Wikipedia pages with supporting textual evidence, (2) claim mutation to generate challenging counterfactual claims with refuting evidence, and (3) an automatic validation step to validate that the generated claims are either supported or refuted by their accompanying evidence, or if the evidence does not provide enough information to judge the validity of the claims. The resulting dataset comprises 181,976 claim-evidence pairs labeled as supported, refuted, or not enough information. Human evaluation carried out on a test sample from the dataset demonstrated strong inter-annotator agreement (kappa = 0.89) using Cohen's Kappa for supported claims and (kappa = 0.94) for refuted claims. Automatic validation based on a human-evaluated sample achieved 86% accuracy for supported claims and 88% for refuted ones. To showcase Arafa's value as a resource for automatic Arabic fact-checking, four open-source transformer-based models were fine-tuned using Arafa, with the top-performing model achieving a Macro F1-score of 77% on the test data. In addition to Arafa being the first large-scale dataset for Arabic fact-checking, our framework presents a scalable approach for developing similar resources for other low-resource languages.
2609.25833.paper_summary_zh: 自動事實查核在阿拉伯語自然語言處理中面臨重大挑戰，因為數據集和資源稀缺。在這篇手稿中，我們介紹了Arafa，一個新的大規模現代標準阿拉伯語事實查核數據集，通過一個利用大型語言模型（LLMs）的自動化框架構建而成。該數據集是通過三步驟流程構建的：（1）從阿拉伯語維基百科頁面生成帶有支持文本證據的主張，（2）主張變異以生成具有反駁證據的挑戰性反事實主張，以及（3）自動驗證步驟，以驗證生成的主張是否得到其附帶證據的支持或反駁，或證據是否未提供足夠的信息來判斷主張的有效性。最終生成的數據集包含181,976對標記為支持、反駁或信息不足的主張-證據對。對數據集中測試樣本進行的人類評估顯示，在支持主張方面，標註者之間的協議度很高（kappa = 0.89），在反駁主張方面則為（kappa = 0.94）。基於人類評估樣本的自動驗證對支持主張的準確率達到86%，對反駁主張則為88%。為了展示Arafa作為自動阿拉伯語事實查核資源的價值，四個基於開源Transformer的模型使用Arafa進行了微調，其中表現最佳的模型在測試數據上達到了77%的宏觀F1分數。除了Arafa是首個大規模阿拉伯語事實查核數據集外，我們的框架還提供了一種可擴展的方法，用於為其他低資源語言開發類似的資源。
